Acceptance: phase-1 corpus is licence-clean per item; method: audit a random sample of 1,000 ingested items per source against upstream licence metadata, with negative fixtures (an NC item, a paywalled item) that ingest must reject

Acceptance: deltas keep the corpus fresh within budget; method: replay a week of daily jobs against recorded API responses, including a merged and a deleted ID, asserting visibility of new works, tombstone handling, credits within the daily allowance and a correct freshness report

Acceptance: retrieval is correct over base and deltas; method: golden-query suite over a fixed corpus asserting recall floors for BM25, vector and hybrid; a base-plus-three-deltas fixture asserting no superseded or tombstoned row is returned; a busy-queue simulation asserting reranked false

Acceptance: model mismatch is explicit; method: protocol contract tests where a vector with a wrong model id, version or dimension is rejected with the documented error, a matching vector is accepted, text input is embedded hub-side, and the capabilities response matches a recorded snapshot

Acceptance: the document model round-trips and holds no PDFs; method: snapshot tests of the model on golden-set fixtures from JATS, TEI, HTML, PDF and USPTO XML, a field-by-field round trip of a sample against the source, and a scan asserting no PDF bytes in any product

Acceptance: extraction faults are caught and tiers are licence-gated; method: golden-set regression run with red/green fixtures, a seeded extraction fault that must be flagged and quarantined, and a gating test proving T4 is unreachable for an item outside CC-BY, CC0 and public domain

Acceptance: provenance is complete and visible; method: a completeness check on a sealed fixture product (every input resolvable by hash and URL) plus response contract tests asserting seal or version, attribution and answered_by on every record

Acceptance: only permitted classes are served and gated paths are off; method: negative tests where rows of a disallowed class are never returned by get or search, NC and ND fixtures are refused by the paid-tier build, and gated handlers are verified unreachable in the phase-1 configuration

Acceptance: retracted works are flagged everywhere they are served; method: fixture records that match a retraction list by DOI and by PMID must show status and date on search and get, while non-matching records stay unflagged

Acceptance: an agent can ground answers and its citations resolve; method: an end-to-end MCP session against a mock hub over a seeded corpus asserting every cited ID resolves, untrusted-content wrapping and the presence of provenance, licence and answered_by, then the grounding benchmark on a pinned release

Acceptance: protocol conformance and bounded fall-through; method: contract tests against recorded hub responses, fault injection (hub down, hub slow) asserting a bounded fall-through with answered_by, an unchanged client suite with no hub configured, and the conformance kit run against the reference implementation

Acceptance: layers isolate and resolve correctly; method: a permission-matrix test across personal, group, organisation and global layers covering read, write and leak-upward attempts, asserting layer and author on every annotation

Acceptance: offline search and detach work; method: detach a tracked-works fixture on a clean profile with the network disabled, verify the per-paper product with the sealed-product verifier, test local-subset routing, and assert no bulk-export endpoint exists

Acceptance: tenants are isolated and usage is metered; method: tenant simulation on microVMs with two tenants, a cross-read attempt that must fail, and a metering reconciliation against generated usage

Acceptance: a clean install serves the protocol; method: install on a clean machine from the NixOS module, OCI image and Helm chart, run the protocol smoke suite, and serve one sealed shard unchanged from a hosted-stage instance and an on-prem instance

Acceptance: privacy obligations are met before launch; method: a launch-gate checklist (assessment and notice exist and are reviewed), an erasure test asserting an erased author is absent from search while the hash is retained, and a log-retention test

Acceptance: opt-outs are honoured on every re-ingest; method: opt-out fixtures (robots.txt, TDMRep, a noai header, ai.txt) that a re-ingest must skip and record, plus a replay where an opt-out appears between two ingests and must take effect

Acceptance: the hub can be restored and cleaned up safely; method: a restore drill from backup into an empty host, a retention-policy test (an old base expires by policy, never by ad-hoc delete), a log scan asserting no secret appears, and a budget-cap test asserting work queues rather than skips

Acceptance: serving is CPU-only and GPU use obeys the queue policy; method: a lab-scale load test (twenty simulated users) on a CPU-only host recording p95 per step, plus a lint asserting every GPU submission declares VRAM, a checkpoint and a new output directory

Acceptance: every release is licence-clean; method: release-checklist automation asserting SPDX expressions and licence files are present, NOTICE and SBOM are generated, the dependency licence check passes and no model weights sit in the image layers

System: Licence determination at ingest; method: audit a random sample of 1,000 ingested items per source against upstream licence metadata; replay negative fixtures (a CC-BY-NC item, a paywalled item, an item with no licence field) through ingest

System: Sealed shard builds and collection layout; method: build the base from a recorded sample release on ksb, verify the collection layout and shard sizes, then compare the per-source row counts in `coverage` with the upstream counts

System: OpenAlex delta sync within the free-key budget; method: replay seven days of daily jobs against recorded API responses including a merged and a deleted ID, with a metered fake of the credit header
System: Weekly patent-grant delta; method: ingest two recorded weekly grant files into a base fixture and measure the delay from the release timestamp to searchability on the replayed clock

System: Base, delta and current-pointer lifecycle; method: base plus three deltas fixture with updated, merged and deleted IDs; query every ID before and after a compaction and a pointer switch; kill the process mid-compaction

System: Licence-gated extraction cascade; method: gating test over fixtures of every licence class asserting the highest reachable tier; a cap test with an exhausted budget asserting queueing; a counter audit of calls per tier

System: Extraction quality control and golden loop; method: run the golden set with red and green fixtures; seed a fault into a batch and confirm detection; compute the QC pass rate and the sample result per batch

System: Document-model storage; method: golden fixtures from JATS, TEI, HTML, PDF and USPTO XML; field-by-field round trip against the source; a byte scan of every product for the PDF magic number; a figure decode compare
System: Provenance recording; method: completeness check over a sealed fixture product and over a 10,000-row sample of the stage-0 products: resolve every provenance field and every input hash
System: Retraction flags joined at index build; method: join audit: fixture records matching a retraction list by DOI and by PMID, plus non-matching controls; run at each index build

System: Hot tier layout on the KC3000; method: apply the layout script to a scratch btrfs image, then check names, properties, quotas and the sum of limits; fill a subvolume past its quota and confirm the write fails while the neighbours are unaffected
System: Local NVMe random access for indexes; method: fio random-read job (4 KiB, queue depth 8, 60 s) against the `index` mount from inside the hub microVM, and again on the host for reference

System: Object tiers per project; method: red/green permission matrix per role and bucket (allowed passes, denied fails, including research overwrite and cross-project read) and an expiry test per tier on shortened clocks

System: Raw and intermediate store: keep everything; method: ingest an open-access PDF and a TEI fixture through T1 to T3, assert every raw input and tier output is stored by hash, fill the stage-0 raw budget so ingest pauses without deleting, refuse a hand-drop without a recorded hash, and check gpu-io/in and the hand-off prefix are empty after acceptance
System: Warm tier on the storage host; method: migrate the KC3000 `keep` bucket to the warm box with a checksum-verified copy, compare object listings and hashes, run a scrub and a snapshot
System: Cold tier on the Storage Box; method: run a backup of a seeded dataset, `restic check --read-data-subset=5%`, and inspect the repository for plaintext markers

System: Retention policy; method: create three bases on a test bucket; run the retention job and assert the oldest expires by policy; attempt an ad-hoc delete with every other role and assert denial; audit the log
System: BM25 index; method: build the index over a 10⁸-document synthetic corpus plus the real stage-0 corpus; run 1,000 filtered queries single-threaded; tamper with a stamp and query
System: Vector index; method: compare ANN against exact search on 1,000 golden queries over a million-chunk sample; time the ANN step; check the recorded index kind in `capabilities`
System: Graph neighbours; method: load a citation fixture with known neighbourhoods and time 1,000 depth-1 and depth-2 queries; compare returned sets against the fixture

System: Index freshness and rebuild; method: seal a delta and time the interval to searchability; delete the index directory and rebuild from products, timing it and comparing golden-query results before and after
System: Hybrid search latency at lab scale; method: load test with 20 simulated users replaying a golden-query mix against the stage-0 corpus on a CPU-only host, recording p95 per step
System: Rerank fallback; method: simulate a saturated rerank queue (fake worker that never answers) and issue 500 searches
System: CPU-only serving; method: inspect the serving unit and microVM definition for GPU devices; sample `nvidia-smi` process memory on the host while the load test runs
System: Get, neighbours and snippet responses; method: contract tests against the protocol schema plus a timed run of 1,000 `get` calls of 100 IDs and a size check of 1,000 search pages
System: Protocol surface; method: schema conformance of every call against the crate types; licence check of the crate manifest; a response scan for the version field

System: Capabilities, coverage and the embedding contract; method: send vectors with a wrong model id, a wrong version and a wrong dimension and a matching one; text input; compare `capabilities` and `coverage` to a recorded snapshot before and after a delta
System: Response metadata and untrusted text; method: response contract tests across all calls over a seeded corpus, scanning every record for the five fields and every text field for the wrapper
System: Standalone MCP server; method: end-to-end MCP session against a mock hub over a seeded corpus; grounding benchmark on a pinned release
System: Conformance kit; method: run the verifier against the reference hub on stage 0
System: Fall-through and unchanged client; method: fault injection: hub down, hub slow (10 s) and hub erroring, 200 queries each; run the unchanged client suite with no hub configured

System: Detach hands back structured documents, never PDF bytes; method: detach a tracked-works fixture on a clean profile with the network disabled afterwards; verify the per-paper product; scan every `detach` and `open` response for PDF bytes
System: Local-subset routing; method: build a 50,000-paper reference subset and measure size and 500 local queries; route a covered and an uncovered query
System: No bulk export; method: enumerate the routes of the hub against an allowlist; attempt `get` of 101 IDs and a `detach` of works the caller does not track
System: Tenant isolation; method: two simulated tenants on microVMs; attempt reads of the other tenant's buckets, files and API; scan the mount tables
System: Usage metering; method: generate a known number of grounded queries across two tenants and reconcile the counters; run the local tier and assert no events
System: Annotation layers; method: permission-matrix test over the 4 layers with read, write and leak-upward attempts for each role
System: On-prem parity; method: install on a clean microVM from each of the three artefacts; run the smoke suite; serve one shard from both and compare bytes
System: Stage portability; method: run the conformance kit and the licence-gating negative suite against each stage that exists, and grep the code for stage conditionals
System: Secrets handling; method: plant canary secrets, run a failure-heavy session (bad key, expired credential, S3 error) and scan every log, error body and response
System: Encryption and access control; method: port scan and handshake probe of the hub and gateway from a peer microVM; anonymous request attempts; check the LUKS status of the pool
System: Privacy controls; method: erase a fixture author and query before and after; age log entries on a shortened clock; scan the schema and logs for per-user read records
System: Freshness, spend and budget telemetry; method: drive each cap to 80 % on a test instance and observe the alert; compare the freshness report with the replayed clock
System: Service health and quota watch; method: fill a test subvolume to 80 % and 90 % and observe the alerts; compare histogram p95 against the load-test log
System: Snapshot schedule; method: run the snapshot job on a scratch image with a shortened clock; delete a file and recover it from the snapshot; count snapshots against the policy
System: Off-box encrypted backup; method: compare the backup set against the inventory of non-rebuildable paths; run backup and `restic check`; confirm no keys on the target
System: Restore from empty host; method: restore the backup set into an empty microVM, rebuild indexes and run the protocol smoke suite and the golden queries
System: GPU submission policy; method: lint every submission template and job wrapper; run a 2-chunk job and kill it between chunks to confirm resumption from the checkpoint
System: GPU job data access; method: run a job that writes a valid output, one that writes a corrupted output and one that tries to write outside its directory; run the promotion step on all three
System: Embedding throughput; method: embed a 5,000,000-chunk sample as chunked jobs and read the throughput from the job logs
System: Backfills off the shared GPU; method: audit the job queue history of the hub project for jobs tagged backfill or re-embed; check the chunk size of ingest jobs
System: Licence class on every row and artefact; method: negative suite with rows of every disallowed class plus a query fuzzer over `get` and `search`
System: Gated features off in phase 1; method: enumerate routes and handler registrations in the phase-1 build and attempt each gated call
System: Paid-tier exclusion of NC and ND content; method: build a paid-tier index from a fixture containing NC and ND rows and scan the result
System: TDM opt-out honoured on every ingest; method: opt-out fixtures for each of the four mechanisms present at the first ingest of a source, and a late opt-out between two ingests
System: Release hygiene; method: release-checklist automation on a candidate build: SPDX and file presence, NOTICE and SBOM generation, allowlist check and a layer scan for weight files
ETL run orchestrator and run ledger

System: ETL run orchestrator and run ledger; method: fixture ingest: assert a run record exists before step 1 and pins every input, the slice manifest and the definition hashes; start runs with an unpinned input and with a changed upstream hash; re-run a CPU run from its record and diff the output hashes
Resumable, verified downloads

System: Resumable, verified downloads; method: local HTTP server with range support and a published checksum: kill the downloader at 10 %, 50 % and 99 %, resume, corrupt the tail, change the ETag between attempts, and serve a source with no checksum
Canonical-first product write and copy verification

System: Canonical-first product write and copy verification; method: kill the product write between the keep write, the keep verification, the hot copy and the hot rename; flip a byte in the keep copy and in the hot copy; restart and let the hub reconcile; trace the write order in the ledger
Promotion after QC, atomic switch and rollback

System: Promotion after QC, atomic switch and rollback; method: qC pass and fail fixtures; 100,000 concurrent reads while `current` switches; kill during the switch; roll back after promotion and compare golden queries; attempt retention of the previous generation inside the 7-day soak
Crash-resume of a run

System: Crash-resume of a run; method: kill a fixture run at every step boundary and mid-step, and kill a 2-chunk GPU run between chunks; resume; compare output hashes, credit and budget counters and orphan files with an uninterrupted run; stop at a full quota and resume after space is added
GPU output acceptance

System: GPU output acceptance; method: six jobs: a valid one, a manifest that does not match the files, a missing manifest, an extra file, a job id not in the ledger, and a file modified by a second process after the job ended (also during the hub's copy); run the acceptance step on each
Explicit corpus slice transfer to ksb

System: Explicit corpus slice transfer to ksb; method: build a slice, transfer it to ksb, list the files on ksb against the manifest, flip a byte in transit, include a CC-BY-NC fixture row, and end the task
Page renders and region crops from kept originals

nodes.title: System: Page renders and region crops from kept originals; method: render a page and crop a region from a kept PDF fixture; request crops for permitted and non-permitted licence classes; attempt a listing of crops and a page-scale PDF request; fill the render cache past its bound; attach a crop to a confirmed report
Image embeddings of figures and page regions

System: Image embeddings of figures and page regions; method: embed a 200,000-figure sample as chunked GPU jobs at 512 and at full dimension; compare recall@10 on the golden image queries; read the product metadata; read throughput from the job logs
Vision tiers re-run on demand from stored inputs

System: Vision tiers re-run on demand from stored inputs; method: re-run T1, T2, T3 and T4 on a chosen element and on a batch of a kept fixture with the network disabled; hash the old intermediates before and after; request T4 for a non-permitted class
Service registry

System: Service registry; method: negative suite of at least 8 definitions: a missing field, a gpu_submit executor without VRAM, normal priority, a T3 and a T4 without a budget cap, T4 with a non-permitted class, an escalation cycle, a model without weights hash; then run a job whose weights differ from the definition's hash; resolve every historical definition hash from `keep`
Definition hash in the run ledger and in every row's provenance

System: Definition hash in the run ledger and in every row's provenance; method: run a fixture cascade through three definitions; read the ledger and sample 1,000 output rows; try to start a step and to write a row with a missing or unknown definition hash
Re-derive by definition hash; executor change is configuration

System: Re-derive by definition hash; executor change is configuration; method: select "everything produced by definition X" on a fixture and compare with the ledger; change T3's executor between two fixture definitions with no code change, re-derive, and grep the code for host and model names
Sage overflow data path (only if an overflow definition targets sage)

System: Sage overflow data path (only if an overflow definition targets sage); method: with no sage definition enabled, audit credentials and connections; with an overflow definition enabled in a fixture, fetch a payload as the T3 worker, attempt a cross-prefix read, return a result with a bad manifest and a good one, and list sage after acceptance
